2607.22098.title: Reasoning Denoiser: Denoising Reasoning Traces for Hallucination Detection in Large Reasoning Models
2607.22098.paper_summary: Large reasoning models (LRMs) generate long reasoning traces before producing final answers. While these traces may contain useful signals for hallucination detection, harnessing them is non-trivial because long trajectories often include noisy steps that obscure the cues relevant to truthfulness assessment. In this paper, we identify two prevalent forms of reasoning noises, i.e., irrelevant steps and repetitive steps, and show that both substantially degrade hallucination detection performance. Existing confidence-based scores and naive embedding-based filtering fail to reliably separate noisy from informative steps. To address this challenge, we propose REDE, a novel learning framework for denoising reasoning traces for hallucination detection. Specifically, REDE leverages final-answer attention as an automatic supervision signal to shape the step-level representation space, yielding refined embeddings in which noisy steps can be reliably identified and filtered. REDE can be readily plugged into diverse hallucination detectors by operating on the filtered reasoning trajectory after removing noisy steps. Extensive experiments on multiple reasoning benchmarks show that REDE consistently improves detection performance over competitive baselines.
2607.22098.paper_summary_zh: 大型推理模型（LRMs）在產生最終答案之前會生成長的推理痕跡。雖然這些痕跡可能包含對於幻覺檢測有用的信號，但利用它們並非易事，因為長的軌跡通常包含噪音步驟，這些步驟會掩蓋與真實性評估相關的線索。在本文中，我們識別了兩種常見的推理噪音形式，即無關步驟和重複步驟，並顯示這兩者都會顯著降低幻覺檢測性能。現有的基於信心的分數和天真的嵌入過濾方法無法可靠地將噪音步驟與信息步驟區分開來。為了解決這一挑戰，我們提出了REDE，一種新穎的學習框架，用於對推理痕跡進行去噪，以便進行幻覺檢測。具體而言，REDE利用最終答案注意力作為自動監督信號來塑造步驟級別的表示空間，從而產生精煉的嵌入，這些嵌入中可以可靠地識別和過濾噪音步驟。REDE可以輕鬆地插入到各種幻覺檢測器中，通過在去除噪音步驟後對過濾的推理軌跡進行操作。對多個推理基準的廣泛實驗表明，REDE始終在競爭基準上提高檢測性能。
